def load():
    import os,re
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
i,o=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    # find line: row of a single repeated color that's not the dominant background
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    lr=None; lc=None
    for r,row in enumerate(g):
        s=set(row)-{bg}
        if len(s)==1 and len(row)-row.count(bg)>w//2:
            lr,lc=r,s.pop(); break
    # find object: cells not bg, not line
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (bg,lc)]
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    obj=[[g[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    # erase object
    for r,c in pts: g[r][c]=bg
    oh=r1-r0+1
    # move to other side of line, adjacent
    if r0>lr: nr=lr-oh  # above
    else: nr=lr+1       # below
    for j,row in enumerate(obj):
        for k2,v in enumerate(row):
            g[nr+j][c0+k2]=v
    # draw 8-line adjacent on far side of object
    er = nr-1 if r0>lr else nr+oh
    g[er]=[8]*w
    return g
